materialDefect.summary: Original encoder excludes ArrayBuffer returned by installed @libsql/client for SQLite BLOBs. JSON encoding silently converts the BLOB to {}; backup CLI exits 0 but actual CLI restore exits 1 with a bind-type error.
materialDefect.originalError: SQLite3 can only bind numbers, strings, bigints, buffers, and null
materialDefect.proposalCheck: git apply --check succeeded against original source; no main source edits

patchedProof.scope: Patched disposable copy only; root must integrate proposal and rerun release checks.
patchedProof.allRowsCompared: Exact normalized row multisets per table, including sqlite_sequence; binary values compared as bytes.
patchedProof.stockAndFinancialValues: Exact equality covers stock/reservations, price/cost, orders 4497 and 5997 EUR minor units, card balances 20503 and 9003, issue/redeem ledger, and cash refund 1234.
patchedProof.filesystemUpload: One actual 68-byte PNG with safe 32-hex basename; SHA-256 compared.

limits: Local Linux SQLite CLI evidence only; no production database, real .env, real credentials, .venv, network or providers accessed.
No production/offsite SSH, customer staging login/cutover, retention-law or Windows validation.
Restore is not globally atomic. Occupied uploads refusal actually left 32 app table definitions in its isolated target; all failed targets were discarded.
Wrong key in this run left an empty SQLite file with zero user schema objects; this is an observed result, not a promise that every failure is atomic.
Database uses a snapshot, but filesystem uploads are read separately; no concurrent media replacement drill was performed.
Only safe-named png/jpg/webp files up to 2 MiB are included.
Built-in foreign-key/integrity PRAGMA errors can be suppressed; independent successful PRAGMA executions were checked in this drill.
Export assumes rowid tables; arbitrary WITHOUT ROWID schemas were not tested.
Remote provider aliases and hardlink identity are outside this local URL/source guard proof.
Synthetic encrypted artifacts and random keys were intentionally disposed after verification; retained evidence contains sanitized commands, hashes, counts, source references and proposal only.
